thread:
ana: T-minus 20 — change window opens in 20 minutes (12:00 UTC). Quick sweep: smoke, canary, pin plan, release notes?
kevin: Release notes posted: https://releases.redwood.dev/notes/v2.3.4 — batching perf, kv-cache fix, quantization tweak. TL;DR in the doc.
sasha: Canaries pre-warmed in prod-us-east and eu-west. Stage smoke passed 3m ago.
deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED — release=v2.3.4 env=prod-us-east canary_id=cb-20260321-01
platform-oncall: Observability: pool-gpu-3 transient mem spike at 12:02 UTC, gpumem ~88% but no OOMs. p95 latency currently 320ms.
tariq: Watching latency and error budget. If p95 > 500ms for >3m or 5xx >5% -> rollback plan triggered.
kevin: Pinning plan: edge routes -> pin v2.3.3 until canary stable; mobile/desktop gradual traffic shift to v2.3.4.
ana: (typo) ana: ^ corrected. Owners on watch: tariq (metrics), sasha (smoke + deploy), kevin (pinning)
sasha: Smoke checklist ran: ./scripts/smoke.sh --env prod-us-east --release v2.3.4 -> all checks pass except redis conn latency (low jitter).
deploy-bot: METRIC ALERT canary_id=cb-20260321-01 anomalies detected: 5xx_rate=6.2% (threshold=5.0%).
tariq: I can repro a tokenizer fallback in logs around 12:04 — those 500s line up with embedding handler exceptions.
ana: (again) ana: Hold on full rollout. Tariq, take control: initiate canary rollback and pin edge.
tariq: Initiating rollback now. Command I'm running:
```
deployctl rollback --canary cb-20260321-01 --reason "5xx spike - tokenizer fallback"
deployctl pin --route edge --version v2.3.3 --owner kevin
```
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED canary_id=cb-20260321-01 actor=tariq
platform-oncall: Noted — telemetry retention increased for this window, pulling raw traces to S3 for postmortem.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE canary_id=cb-20260321-01 status=success
kevin: Pin enforced on edge -> v2.3.3. Mobile/desktop rollouts halted.
ana: (ana) Recording decision: abort full rollout, capture logs, owners: tariq/sasha for fix, kevin for pin audit. Postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.dev/postmortems/2026-03-21-canary-5xx
sasha: I'll queue a retest after the tokenizer fallback patch and an extended smoke run. Target re-canary ~24h.
tariq: +1. For follow-up: add unit test for tokenizer fallback, add stronger 5xx alerting with a 1min trigger.
kevin: OK. Closing this window. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ana: Good coordination. I'll ping legal/support if customers noticed regressions. Thread closed.
summary: Canary for v2.3.4 triggered a 5xx spike; team held rollout, rolled back canary, pinned edge to v2.3.3, and opened a follow-up postmortem.
